name: scene-mankurad
title: Mankurad
description: A short story about a mango in coloured pencil: it ripens in the May heat while a koel calls, clouds come in, the first monsoon rain falls, and it drops into a puddle on red laterite. Hatched tone, boiling outlines, a noise-driven pendulum. Quiet is the plate's still; warm tells the story at an easy pace; playful tells it again on Enter. Set progress and the story holds at that beat, a gentle order or delivery tracker.

budget.reason: The plate's painters and sprite cache for a whole short story, ported line for line.
